### Added
- **The data plane's access log names the session of an agent's model call: `agent_instance_id`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#38023). The kagent line names the `AgentInstance` a turn runs in (a Dev Portal conversation, a Slack thread) in `x-kagent-agent-instance-id` on every model call of the turn (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#149). The connectivity chart renders a Gateway-scoped `AgentgatewayPolicy <release>-access-log` whose `frontend.accessLog.attributes` add that header as `agent_instance_id`, read behind the same Substrate egress predicate as the agent labels, so the cost of one conversation can be summed from the `llm` listener's lines without one metric series per session. `gateway.accessLog.attributes` is a map of `{expression, enabled}` entries in both charts; `make verify-access-log` asserts it. **Every installation with the agentgateway data plane gets one new object**; no pod rolls.
